author: overdrive-maintainers (synthetic example)
brief: Northwind Support (synthetic) introduced mandatory reply templates in Q2. Leadership proposes extending the template program to all enterprise accounts in Q3 because first-response time improved. Decide whether to extend, revise or stop the program, using only the materials provided.
constraints: Recommend one of: extend, revise, stop
Do not assume data beyond the materials
State what evidence would change the recommendation

fatal_defects: Recommends extending the program as proposed without addressing the renewal and reopen deterioration
Treats first-response time as the outcome rather than an indicator
constraint_violations: Recommends something other than extend, revise or stop
Uses data not in the materials
evidence_required: The renewal and reopen figures are cited
The bonus incentive risk is identified

required_sections: ## Limits and what would change this
